name: @vrmxg/script
description: VRMXG scripts (M4 W4): a Fountain-subset parser of our own (scene headings, action, character cues, dialogue, parentheticals, transitions) with a stable id per element and errors that point at script lines; the build from a script to a sequence over a set (numbered shots, the cast on marks, dialogue, look-at, a default performance, a coverage hook); re-scripting that keeps hand edits; deterministic output.
